prompts.title: Lola Lago — Vacaciones al sol
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a finished original illustrated front cover for a Spanish-language reading library.
Output: ONE flat, full-bleed vertical cover, 2:3 aspect ratio. The artwork IS the cover, viewed straight on, with no book mockup, spine, tabletop, frame or surrounding background.
Art direction: premium editorial gouache illustration, subtle printed-paper grain, confident painterly shapes, beautifully observed light, refined limited color palette, clear focal silhouette and cinematic depth. A carefully art-directed literary cover, never stock clipart, generic AI fantasy montage, glossy 3D or a crowded collage. Make it compelling both at full size and as a small library thumbnail.

Scene: the sunlit Costa Brava, a luminous Mediterranean cove below the old stone walls and terracotta roofs of Tossa de Mar. A small restaurant terrace creates an inviting foreground. An observant Spanish woman in her early thirties, short dark pixie haircut, warm olive skin, expressive dark eyes, cream shirt and muted coral jacket, looks out toward the sea in a relaxed three-quarter pose. She is a believable private detective on holiday, not a glamorous spy. A small closed notebook rests beside her on the terrace table. Quiet intrigue beneath a beautiful summer day, no criminals or violence.
Palette and mood: deep Mediterranean teal, ultramarine, warm limestone, terracotta and sunlit cream; sophisticated, airy and warm. Strong elegant shapes, not tourist-postcard kitsch.
Text (verbatim), with these separate lines and hierarchy:
Small series line: "LOLA LAGO"
Very large title: "VACACIONES" / "AL SOL"
Small bottom credit: "LOURDES MIQUEL · NEUS SANS"
